name: @shinsa/desktop
description: Shinsa for Mac: the app around the Shinsa engine

scripts.package: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun ../engine/scripts/build-engine.ts && bun run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null && codesign --force --deep --sign - release/mac-arm64/Shinsa.app
scripts.package:canary: bun run --cwd ../web build && SHINSA_FLAVOR=canary bun ../engine/scripts/build-engine.ts && SHINSA_FLAVOR=canary bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.canary.yml --mac --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null && codesign --force --deep --sign - 'release/mac-arm64/Shinsa Canary.app'
